##### Project general facts

Taj Wellington Mews is a refined waterfront development on Al Marjan Island, where heritage-inspired elegance meets contemporary architectural expression. Defined by two interconnected towers rising above a circular podium, the design creates a distinctive silhouette shaped by fluid lines and thoughtfully integrated balconies. The architecture balances grandeur with subtlety, while expansive layouts and panoramic glazing invite natural light and frame serene coastal views, delivering a living experience rooted in sophistication and calm.

The development is complemented by a curated selection of lifestyle amenities designed to promote wellness, relaxation, and social connection. Landscaped surroundings create a peaceful retreat, while a range of leisure and wellness facilities support a balanced daily routine. Residents can enjoy spaces that encourage both privacy and interaction, all set within an environment that blends the tranquility of island living with refined hospitality-inspired experiences.

Interiors are fully furnished and finished with a rich palette of high-quality materials, combining warm neutral tones with refined accents of gold, brass, and layered textures. Expansive windows enhance natural light, while carefully designed feature elements and ambient lighting create an atmosphere of understated luxury. Kitchens are fully equipped with built-in appliances, ensuring both functionality and elegance, resulting in a seamless, move-in-ready home defined by comfort, craftsmanship, and timeless design.

##### Location description and benefits

Al Marjan Island is a stunning man-made archipelago located in the emirate of Ras Al Khaimah. It is one of the most prominent tourist destinations in the region, known for its picturesque beaches, luxurious resorts, and upscale residential developments. Al Marjan Island is situated along the Arabian Gulf coastline and offers breathtaking views of the sea. The island is shaped like a coral reef and is made up of four primary coral-shaped islands, connected by a central boulevard.

One of the main highlights of Al Marjan Island is its pristine white sandy beaches that stretch across 5.4 kilometers. Visitors can indulge in various beach activities, including sunbathing, swimming, and water sports such as jet skiing and paddleboarding. The crystal-clear waters of the Arabian Gulf provide an ideal setting for water enthusiasts.

Al Marjan Island boasts a collection of luxurious hotels and resorts, offering world-class amenities and services. These accommodations cater to both leisure and business travelers, providing a range of options to suit different preferences and budgets. Many of the hotels and resorts on the island feature stunning architecture and provide access to private beaches, swimming pools, spas, and gourmet dining options.
